import unittest import solution class ExtractGuideLinksTests(unittest.TestCase): def test_collects_only_links_in_qualifying_articles(self): html = """ outside
wrong
one
two
missingempty mail script
""" self.assertEqual( solution.extract_guide_links(html, "https://example.com/docs/index.html"), ["https://example.com/docs/page.html", "https://example.com/absolute?q=1&x=2"], ) def test_deduplicates_after_resolution_and_fragment_removal(self): html = """
first duplicate other
""" self.assertEqual( solution.extract_guide_links(html, "https://example.com/base/"), ["https://example.com/a", "https://other.test/x"], ) def test_nested_qualifying_article_and_parser_recovery(self): html = ( "
One" "
Two
" ) self.assertEqual( solution.extract_guide_links(html, "http://host.test/root/"), ["http://host.test/root/one", "http://host.test/root/two"], ) def test_empty_html_and_fresh_result(self): first = solution.extract_guide_links("", "https://example.com") second = solution.extract_guide_links("", "https://example.com") self.assertEqual(first, []) self.assertIsNot(first, second) def test_argument_types(self): for html, base in ((None, "https://x.test"), ("", None), (b"", "https://x.test")): with self.subTest(html=html, base=base): with self.assertRaises(TypeError): solution.extract_guide_links(html, base) def test_invalid_base_urls(self): for base in ("", "/relative", "example.com/path", "ftp://example.com/x", "https:///missing"): with self.subTest(base=base): with self.assertRaises(ValueError): solution.extract_guide_links("", base) def test_resolved_urls_without_http_host_are_filtered(self): html = "
badbase
" self.assertEqual( solution.extract_guide_links(html, "https://valid.test/path"), ["https://valid.test/path"], ) if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()
